title: 포레스트 벤치
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable 1024 by 1024 square seamless material tile for a football management game's controller background design proposal G1.
Primary request: Deep pine green matte soft-touch sports equipment surface, fine irregular rubber micrograin and sparse slightly lighter green specks. Rich forest green, quiet tactile stadium-bench finish. No cloth weave, no metallic shine, no seams.
Composition: edge-to-edge uniform material, perfectly orthographic flat overhead macro, same tone and texture density at all four edges, seamless repeat, no vignette, no gradient or directional lighting, no obvious repeating geometric motif. Main colour approximately #183e30.
